description: Pay USDC via x402 and fetch a protected HTTP resource in one call. Requires EVM_PRIVATE_KEY on this host; otherwise use x402.probe for a no-spend 402.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identity for quota accounting.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

body.description: Optional raw request body for POST/PUT. Omit for GET.
body.title: Body

headers.description: Optional extra request headers as a string map. Omit if none.
headers.title: Headers

max_price_usdc.description: Optional spend ceiling in USDC. Example: 0.10. Calls above this are blocked.
max_price_usdc.title: Max Price Usdc

method.description: HTTP method for the paid request. Default GET.
method.title: Method

preferred_network.description: Preferred CAIP-2 network. Example: 'eip155:8453' (Base mainnet). Omit to use the server default. Call x402.networks to list options.
preferred_network.title: Preferred Network

url.description: Absolute paid HTTP URL to fetch after settling USDC.
url.title: Url

name: x402.pay_and_fetch
title: Pay and fetch x402 resource
